notes: Simpler first-time setup: pick the library and the AI on one screen, see the speed and time left, and downloads pick up again after a dropped connection or a quit.
Switch between Essentials and Everything, move the library to another folder or drive, and choose which folder Your files searches.
After updating, the app offers a cleaner library without about 2,700 repeated pages. Yours keeps working until the new one is in.
A clearer message when an older Ollama app on your computer can't download a model.
